verdict.rationale: Fin's first-party materials say a support leader can customize tone and answer length and can train Fin on their own tone of voice so it gives consistent answers. They also describe on-brand support in live chat, and help articles exist on giving Fin guidance and running Fin in multiple languages. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that brand voice stays consistent across languages (the multilingual article is title-only), detail on how guidance controls voice across topics, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of voice consistency.
